content.overview: Pfizer commissioned a video concept designed to help its team visualize how a GenAI SaaS service could work in practice. The goal was to communicate the platform as an intuitive, chat-based experience where users can generate a wide range of social media content simply by typing prompts into a conversational interface.
content.challenge: The creative direction focused on making the piece feel highly dynamic, engaging, and forward-looking. The video needed to clearly convey speed, versatility, and ease of use, showing how a single interaction could unlock multiple content outputs tailored for different social platforms. Overall, the objective was to present the service as a smart, streamlined solution for scalable content creation.
content.solution: The solution was to create a dynamic video centered on the demo experience, designed to quickly communicate the core value of the service. Its fast-paced structure helped convey the platform’s ease of use and versatility, showing how multiple types of social media content could be generated through a simple chat-based interaction. Pfizer’s visual identity was carefully respected and adapted to fit the video’s purpose, resulting in a piece that felt both on-brand and engaging.
